means: Span of a result label's validity: begins at the result's as-of time, ends at exactly one terminator from a closed catalog-held set.
A label resolves only against the result whose header declared it; aliases are platform-issued, so content-derived strings mint no ref.
What a reduced view may assert: existence, position and omitted counts as of its time; never absence, completeness, equivalence or safety.

name: declared set is a pure function of the query
claim: The follow-up actions of a query result follow from query text, data kind contracts and policy alone, and only those are callable; any other call is refused as undeclared (docs/platform/query-surface.md P-Q1; instance of hjltjz, cvycil; sibling docs/QUERY.md).

name: bounded replayable ref lifetime
claim: Every result label begins at its as-of time and ends at exactly one catalog-held terminator, get is an as-of read that replays identically and set is compare-and-set on the declared version (docs/platform/query-surface.md P-Q2; extends gsioti, ydsgja, vsbder).

name: reduced view is marked and claim-limited
claim: A reduced view (policy exposure or striped skeleton) carries a header reduction mark that tells a consumer it was reduced, with inline omission markers matching its count, and supports only existence, position and count claims (docs/platform/query-surface.md P-Q3; extends cvmhly, hnuspc; sibling docs/STRIPE.md).

name: labels scoped and not forgeable from content
claim: A label resolves only inside its declaring result and ingested names, payload text or fake declarations cannot mint a callable ref, so a made-up or injected reference is refused (docs/platform/query-surface.md P-Q4; extends cvmhly, glxylm, wrqmen; guards fault hqvmzk).

name: exposure policy is catalog data the consumer cannot loosen
claim: Exposure policy, header decorator defaults and descriptor elision are catalog records with catalog defaults that no consumer, ingested content or set call can change (docs/platform/query-surface.md P-Q5; extends ghttaf, eeroue; sibling docs/QUERY.md).

name: staged intent flow trail needs no new store
claim: Query, header, declared set, ref calls and terminator are reconstructible from existing trail rows plus the declaration record, giving flow lint declared-versus-occurred with no extra store (docs/platform/query-surface.md P-Q6; extends knilmc, dgtcqd; TENETS 18).

means: Instance of query scope (sibling nomenclature mutcns, aka ref scope; docs/QUERY.md#44-scope-and-expiry): a label is addressable only as <result>/<label> against its own result. Platform adds: the pair is validated against the declaration record, and a string spelled in ingested content mints nothing.

Extension of label lifetime (docs/QUERY.md 4.4 @scope: queries N, ticks N, surface): the platform adds a closed terminator set held as catalog data (completed, invalidated, superseded, expired on an epoch grid, epoch-fold, revoked) and as-of replay of get after termination.

name: declared set as a pure function, bound to contracts
claim: Instance of query-ref with declared interactions (sibling chain tail uyhrwh, via oouutw, ryygvc; nomenclature zevxlh declared interaction). Platform adds only: the declared set is hashed (declared_hash) so two bindings (JS, wasm) must produce equal sets, and settability comes from the data kind contract (hjltjz, cvycil). No separate claim beyond the sibling's.
evidence: holds if: same query and policy give the same declared_hash in two bindings; fails if bindings differ. See docs/platform/query-surface.md P-Q1.

name: label scope check at the platform seam
claim: Extension of kinds and labels (sibling chain tail umknat, via qgtkhq, jndljd; label nxevyr, query scope mutcns). Platform adds: resolution is checked against the declaration record, so a label spelled in payload or taken from another result is refused (made-up handle fault hqvmzk). Does not claim labels are non-content-derived; see the open difference in docs/platform/query-surface.md decision 1.
evidence: holds if: a payload spelling a label not in the header, or a valid label under another result id, is refused. Fails if either resolves.
